title: The coinduced contracting operator is continuous
statement: Let $G$ be a profinite group, $A$ a finite ring, and $M$ a left $A$-module with an action of $G$ by $A$-linear automorphisms such that every element has open stabilizer [lem-exc-discrete-modules-abelian]. Give $M$ the discrete topology and put $D(M)=\operatorname{Cont}(G,M)$ with the discrete topology and the action $(h\cdot f)(x)=f(xh)$ [lem-exc-coinduced-discrete-embedding]. For $n\geq0$ put $C^n(G,D(M))=\operatorname{Cont}(G^n,D(M))$. For every $n\geq1$, the formula $h_n(F)(g_1,\ldots,g_{n-1})(x)=F(x,g_1,\ldots,g_{n-1})(1)$ defines an $A$-linear map $h_n:C^n(G,D(M))\to C^{n-1}(G,D(M))$; in particular, its values are continuous cochains.
